label: Local cross-check posteriors in the shared-plus-local profile
description: Conditioning on no flag divides by ν(Fᶜ)^n; the per-index ratio ν(C∩Fᶜ)/ν(Fᶜ) is at most one, equals one under perfect local detection, and equals ν(C) for a truth-independent flag. The no-flag event is a product of the whole shared coordinate with local boxes, so the conditioned shared-condition probability stays κ(G). A single conditioned assertion keeps n−1 no-flag factors, which cancel. Under perfect detection a conditioned assertion and the conditioned some-failure event have probabilities κ(G) and 1−κ(G), so a threshold above one half cannot accept both. Stipulated model; no actual check is claimed to be discriminating or perfect.
